rpc.method: GET /api/convs (API_CONV_LIST) for the conversation list; GET /api/conv (API_CONV_DETAIL) for per-conversation detail. Agent-scoped variants: GET /api/user/agent/conversation/list + /api/user/agent/conversation/v1/detail; sessions: GET /api/user/agent/session/list. Management side-ends (same family): rename /api/conv/title, delete /api/conv/delete, clear /api/convs/clear.
rpc.auth: hy_user + hy_token domain session cookies (Cookie header) asserted by the API server; X-ID (userId) + X-Token (session token) request headers on the axios calls; credentials 'include'/withCredentials. The SPA never writes these cookies in bundle code — replay the captured real session cookie set, do not mint them.
rpc.note: each message id splits on '_' into '{conversationId}_{...}' (index page) — use that to join list entries to per-message history
